item.title: Dropout rate in Mississippi falls to 7%, graduation rate rises
item.description: JACKSON, Miss. (WJTV) - The Mississippi Department of Education (MDE) announced the state’s 2024-25 school-year graduation rate is 90.8%, and the dropout rate is 7%.
